tracks.title: Một Cây Bút, Một Chữ Ký
tracks.subject: Chị Thoa has guarded the steel stationery cabinet on the third floor of a Quy Nhơn trading company for twenty years like a general holding a mountain pass: one ballpoint each, only against the dead one and a signature, director included; the morning her own pen dies mid-form she has to borrow one from the junior clerk she turned away an hour earlier, and he makes her sign for it.

tracks.title: Phấn Xanh Trên Tay Áo
tracks.genre: Vietnamese honky-tonk country shuffle (nhạc đồng quê)
tracks.subject: A husband swears he was working late, but the blue cue chalk on his shirt cuff says bi-a hall, so the next evening his wife walks in, borrows a cue and clears the table, and Thursdays become their night out.

tracks.title: Cứ Đi Chậm Thôi
tracks.genre: Vietnamese thính phòng (bán cổ điển) art-song crossover
tracks.subject: New to Saigon from a canal hamlet in Bến Tre, a woman froze each evening at the kerb of Điện Biên Phủ street until a colleague offered his arm and walked her through the motorbikes, slowly, never stopping, never running; a year on, one ordinary weekend, he is her boyfriend, frozen at the coconut-trunk monkey bridge before her childhood home, and she leads him across by the hand.

tracks.title: Giọng Thuyết Minh Sau Lưng
tracks.genre: Nhạc tiền chiến salon ballad revival (1940s Hanoi tân nhạc)
tracks.subject: A xe ôm driver realises the old woman giving directions over his shoulder is the single voice that narrated every foreign film of his childhood, and at her gate asks her to say 'the end' once more, as she did after every film.

tracks.title: Cô Hạnh Nghỉ Một Tuần
tracks.subject: When the only pharmacist who can read old Dr. Tám's handwriting takes a week off, nobody in the ward can fill a prescription, and the doctor has to print in block capitals like a first-grader until she comes back.

tracks.title: Hốt Hụi Đầu
tracks.subject: a young man who bids a ruinous interest rate to take the first pot of a hụi run by five old high-school classmates so he can buy a second-hand Vespa to take a girl out, then spends the next eleven months paying in on instant noodles while the classmates read out his bid at every meeting

tracks.title: Hộp Sữa Sau Khi Hiến Máu
tracks.subject: a couple whose anniversary ritual is donating blood together every three months at the Hanoi Red Cross blood centre, where he always goes pale and dizzy afterwards and she sits holding the free milk carton and biscuits for him, joking that her blood keeps him going

tracks.title: Huýt Sáo
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old man in Đà Nẵng who has never been able to whistle, secretly practising on the balcony every evening with pursed lips and only air coming out, while his girlfriend inside pretends not to hear, until the night one thin wobbly note finally comes out and she whistles back

tracks.title: Chuồng Cọp Tầng Bốn
tracks.subject: a retired tram driver who welds an iron-cage chuồng cọp extension onto his fourth-floor flat in an old Thành Công collective block so his wife can grow chillies and mint in polystyrene boxes, and keeps quietly repainting it green each time the ward inspector comes to measure it

tracks.title: Hội Vỗ Tay Năm Giờ Sáng
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old office worker who throws his back out lifting a watermelon and, on doctor's orders to move, ends up the only young member of the grandmothers' five a.m. clapping-exercise group by Hoàn Kiếm Lake, who adopt him, correct his posture and send him home with boiled peanuts

tracks.title: Trả Giá Lúc Nửa Đêm
tracks.subject: a girl at the Tết flower market on the night of 28 Tết who wants one kumquat pot, watches the seller drop his price every hour, and waits him out until midnight while her friends beg to go home

tracks.title: Chiều Chủ Nhật Xích Lô
tracks.subject: a retired Hà Nội xích lô driver who still pedals his wife once round Hoàn Kiếm lake every Sunday afternoon, she in the passenger seat pretending to be a tourist asking the price

tracks.title: Ghế Nhựa Lùi Vô
tracks.subject: the owner of a sidewalk cà phê on a Sài Gòn street who drags her blue plastic stools back from the kerb every time the ward inspection motorbike turns the corner, and the regulars who stand up mid-sip and carry their own stools inside without being told

tracks.title: Khoai Lang Đầu Cầu Thang
tracks.subject: a bachelor on the fourth floor of an old Kim Liên collective block who finds a paper bag of warm roasted sweet potatoes on the stairwell landing every evening, and finally sits up on the steps one night to catch who leaves it

tracks.title: Nồi Phở Bốn Giờ Sáng
tracks.subject: a young phở cook who opens his own tiny shop and wakes at four every morning to skim the bone stock, talking to the pot as if it were a business partner while the street is still dark

tracks.title: Cái Võng Ban Công
tracks.mood: bickering, playful, deadpan funny, fond underneath
tracks.subject: a young couple in a Sài Gòn chung cư spending a Sunday arguing over how to hang a new hammock on their two-metre balcony — her between the window grille and the air-con pipe, him diagonally to the clothes rack — until it holds only when they both lie in it

tracks.title: Chìa Khóa Dự Phòng
tracks.subject: a Hải Phòng woman who keeps losing her room key on purpose so she can go back to the young locksmith at the corner shop, until he cuts her a key with a tiny heart filed into its head

tracks.title: Chú Vàng Chào Cờ
tracks.genre: V-folktriotism folk dance-pop with trống cơm
tracks.subject: a yellow village dog in Nam Định that runs to the primary school every Monday for the flag-salute drum, sits in the front row with grade one, and gets his own name in the school newsletter

tracks.title: Chạm Mũi Chân
tracks.subject: a forty-year-old Hà Nội office worker with a stiff back whose physiotherapist sets him one goal for the season: touch his toes before Tết

tracks.title: Mười Hai Giờ Lệch
tracks.subject: a retired Biên Hòa man who collects and repairs old mechanical wall clocks, so every clock in his house strikes noon at a different minute and lunch never starts on time

tracks.title: Lá Thứ Bảy
tracks.subject: a Hà Nội man keeping his girlfriend's monstera alive while she is posted to Đà Nẵng for three months, sending her a photo every time it opens a new leaf

tracks.title: Bảy Con Ốc Thừa
tracks.subject: a young man in a Thủ Đức apartment assembling a flat-pack wardrobe over a whole Sunday, finishing with seven screws left over, and the wardrobe standing anyway

tracks.title: Con Vẹt Bấm Còi
tracks.subject: a parrot in a Gò Vấp alley in Sài Gòn that learns to copy its owner's scooter horn, so every neighbour keeps stepping aside for a motorbike that never comes

tracks.title: Cuốn Từ Điển Mượn
tracks.subject: a man returning, fifteen years late, the English dictionary he borrowed from his high-school teacher in Quy Nhơn, with her pencil notes still in the margins

tracks.title: Cành Sanh Cong
tracks.subject: a Sunday bonsai club meeting in a Nam Định courtyard where eight retirees argue all morning over whether to cut the one crooked branch of a banyan, and end up voting to keep it

tracks.title: Màu Cửa Nhà Tôi
tracks.subject: a woman in Đà Lạt arguing with an old house painter over the colour of her front door, rejecting eleven sample patches on the wall until he quietly mixes the exact faded blue of the door she grew up with

tracks.title: Cái Quạt Bằng Bàn Tay
tracks.mood: petty, cheeky and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a Hà Nội student who orders a cheap standing fan online during a sale and receives a fan the size of his palm, then spends a week arguing with the shop's chat for a refund and ends up keeping it on his desk

tracks.title: Bé Mập Ăn Kiêng
tracks.subject: a Biên Hòa woman whose round corgi is put on a strict diet by the vet, and who keeps slipping it pieces of bánh tráng under the table until the next weigh-in shows it gained half a kilo

tracks.title: Lịch Hẹn Ba Tháng
tracks.subject: a young man in Vĩnh Long who books a teeth cleaning every three months only to see the dental nurse, until she writes her phone number on the back of his appointment card

tracks.title: Lớp Bơi Tám Tuổi
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old Hà Nội office worker who signs up for summer swimming lessons at a public pool and ends up in a class of eight-year-olds who teach him to blow bubbles

tracks.title: Ly Thứ Tư
tracks.subject: four students cramming for a finals exam at a Sài Gòn café until two in the morning, ordering a fourth round of cà phê sữa đá while nobody has turned past page twelve

tracks.title: Băng Cát-Xét Duy Nhất
tracks.subject: a man fixing his late-90s National radio cassette player on the porch with a screwdriver and a pencil, and it only ever plays the one cassette left inside it, a worn Chế Linh tape

tracks.title: Cà Phê Trứng Bảy Giờ
tracks.subject: a Sài Gòn guy living in Hà Nội who whisks egg coffee every morning before work, failing for weeks, until he finally gets the thick foam his girlfriend loves from the café on Hàng Gai

tracks.title: Mảnh Ghép Cuối
tracks.subject: a woman spending a month of evenings on a 2000-piece Hạ Long Bay jigsaw on her living-room floor, finding the last piece missing, and cutting a stand-in from the box lid and painting it with a child's watercolours

tracks.title: Đứng Bên Phải Nha
tracks.subject: two friends riding the new Bến Thành - Suối Tiên metro escalators in its first months, one always standing on the left and blocking the people walking up, until the whole platform starts chanting at him

tracks.title: Vạch Nước Sáu Giờ
tracks.subject: a man who rides onto Long Biên Bridge at six every morning to watch the woman he loves read the Red River water-level gauge staff below, learning the name of every painted mark until she says that is enough to meet her mother

tracks.title: Xô Thứ Một Nghìn
tracks.genre: Vietnamese experimental folk-rap with metal percussion
tracks.subject: a hired crew of four and the family alone (husband, wife, their teenage son, the wife's brother) pouring their Hanoi house's concrete roof slab in one morning by bucket chain, the wife's mother on a plastic stool writing down whoever passes slowly, and the eight of them sitting on the still-wet roof when she finally opens the beer

tracks.title: Diều Đê Ngõ Chợ
tracks.subject: kids of one Hanoi alley off the Yên Phụ dike road hauling every kite they own up onto the dike on one windy dry-season afternoon, trying to keep as many in the air at once as they can, until their strings tangle with the kites from the next alley and both gangs end up on the slope unknotting them together (not a formal contest)

tracks.title: Rồi Răng Nữa?
tracks.subject: an old woman in a Huế garden house reading aloud on the porch the letters from her late-life pen-friend, a retired teacher in Quy Nhơn she met through a newspaper column, while her husband pretends to read the paper and keeps asking 'rồi răng nữa?'

tracks.title: Đếm Mạ Bằng Tiếng Tây Ban Nha
tracks.subject: a Vietnamese rice engineer on a cooperation project in Los Palacios, Cuba, who counts seedlings wrong in Spanish all afternoon beside the Cuban agronomist Yanelis, teaches her to ask 'ăn cơm chưa', and files for an extension after three harvests

tracks.title: Câu Thơ Trong Vành Nón
tracks.subject: a man who crosses by boat to a Huế conical-hat maker's yard, orders a nón bài thơ and asks her to hide a line of poetry between the leaf layers of the brim; when he holds it up to the sun the cut-paper line is hers, not the verses he brought

tracks.title: Lớp Sơn Thứ Mười Một
tracks.subject: an apprentice in a Hạ Thái lacquer workshop wet-sanding and re-coating the same black tray for its eleventh layer while the boss taps out the layers on the bench like a DJ counting bars

tracks.title: Gặt Cói Nga Sơn
tracks.genre: Thanh Hóa hò sông Mã folk-pop
tracks.mood: teasing, sun-baked and full of work energy
tracks.subject: a garment-factory worker home from Bắc Ninh for one week of the June sedge harvest in Nga Sơn, cutting cói with her aunt's women's team who call hò sông Mã lines to keep the sickles together and tease her blistered city hands until she calls a line back

tracks.title: Bướm Đêm Tên Lớp Mình
tracks.subject: a Hanoi biology student on a summer moth survey in Hoàng Liên National Park who hangs a white sheet under a lamp every night, logs two hundred and twelve moths, and names the unidentified ones after her classmates in the class group chat, until her lecturer says the one named after Ngân may be a new species

tracks.title: Ba Trăm Mét Trước Bình Minh
tracks.subject: a Hanoi tree crew moving a century-old banyan overnight for a road widening, wrapping the root ball in burlap and wire and inching it 300 metres on a low trailer to its new pit before the first morning traffic

tracks.title: Phun Muỗi Tới Rồi
tracks.subject: the smallest nurse on a Saigon ward health station's dengue-fogging crew, carrying the twelve-kilogram fogger on her shoulder through the alleys one Saturday after three dengue cases in alley 187: kids count her in as she pulls the starter and chase the white smoke, aunties slam their doors until they see larvae swimming in the water bowls under their own cabinet legs, and the crew clears the last alley just before the evening rush

tracks.title: Dế Mèn Quá Hạn
tracks.subject: a Hanoi district librarian retiring on Friday who tracks down the boy who borrowed Dế Mèn phiêu lưu ký in 2014, works out his fine to the đồng including leap years, finds him at the fire station reading it to his crew on night shifts, stamps it returned and lends it to him again as her last loan

tracks.title: Anh Ơi, Tuyết Nè
tracks.subject: a Saigon couple who saved one 500,000-đồng note a month for five years for their first trip abroad, seeing snow for the first time in Sapporo and building a cup-sized snowman on the hotel windowsill with a convenience-store mandarin for a nose

tracks.title: Giọng Vịt Đực
tracks.subject: the only boy in a Phú Thọ lower-secondary school's hát Xoan club, made to hold the drum and lead the giáo trống call as the kép opposite twelve girl đào, whose voice starts breaking in February and squawks like a drake on the high note at every rehearsal; at the Hùng Kings' anniversary performance in the village đình it cracks again in front of the whole village, the twelve đào drown it out in unison, the front-row children quack along all evening and the village head asks him to keep the duck next year

tracks.title: Oxyz, Tha Cho Tao
tracks.subject: a Year-12 student in the last fifteen minutes of the national graduation exam's ninety-minute maths paper on a 39-degree June afternoon, three Oxyz geometry questions blank, a snapped 2B pencil and the invigilator's footsteps coming down the aisle

tracks.title: Hổng Nở Tui Đền
tracks.subject: a young Saigon gardener going house to house in Phú Nhuận on the fifteenth of the twelfth lunar month to strip the leaves off customers' potted yellow mai trees, promising each tree will open on Tết morning or he pays them back, while a café owner on Hoa Sứ street wants his open two days early and the neighbour's boy phones every morning to report cracked buds

tracks.title: Chày Anh, Chày Em
tracks.genre: Khmer Nam Bộ rom vong folk-pop
tracks.subject: two young Khmer sweethearts in Trà Vinh sharing one wooden mortar to pound cốm dẹp on the full-moon night of Ok Om Bok, his pestle coming down each time hers goes up, so neither can look away without the pestles clashing

tracks.title: Tờ Vé Trong Vành Nón
tracks.subject: a lottery-ticket seller in her sixties who walks the same twelve cafés on Phan Xích Long every afternoon, knows each regular's lucky number, and keeps one ticket a day in her hat brim that she never checks

tracks.title: Đi Bão Tới Sáng
tracks.subject: riding đi bão round Hoàn Kiếm Lake all night on the back of a friend's motorbike after Vietnam wins a football final in the ninety-fourth minute, banging a pot lid taken from the bia hơi stall, and croaking through the next morning's meeting to find the boss has lost his voice too

tracks.title: Vịt Đi Trước, Xe Đi Sau
tracks.subject: a Quảng Nam duck herder walking two thousand ducks south along the shoulder of Highway 1A at dusk, from the harvested Duy Xuyên fields to Thăng Bình, a flag tied to his bamboo pole, holding up a tour bus and arguing with a Grab rider taking a passenger to Chu Lai airport, who ends up crawling behind with his headlight on the ducks

tracks.title: Ly Cà Phê Qua Mạn Ghe
tracks.genre: Mekong folktronica with hò Nam Bộ
tracks.subject: a girl selling iced coffee from a sampan at Cái Răng floating market who passes cups on a bamboo pole to a shy pineapple-boat man and charges him double until he says her name

tracks.title: Chấm Xanh Trên Bản Đồ
tracks.subject: a man who stays up every night watching his girlfriend's ride-hailing driver dot crawl across the Saigon map until it parks outside their building, then goes down with a warm bowl of noodles

tracks.title: Kêu Lô Tô Đêm Ba Mươi
tracks.subject: a shy delivery boy drafted to call the numbers at his alley's Tết lô tô night, who starts rhyming the numbers and wins over the whole street

tracks.title: Cuộn Băng Trong Máy Akai
tracks.subject: a young man repairing a 1970s Akai reel-to-reel deck in a Chợ Lớn alley shop who finds a half-finished tape of a stranger's love song inside and spends a week trying to find the singer

tracks.title: Giàn Giáo Tre
tracks.subject: a bamboo-scaffolding builder lashing poles seven floors up on a narrow Hanoi Old Quarter tube house while a storm wind comes in off the Red River

tracks.title: Ai Đang Gõ Vậy
tracks.subject: five students in one shared document at three in the morning finishing a group report due at eight, and one of them typing into the wrong section the whole night

tracks.title: Thiếu Pa-tê
tracks.subject: a diss track aimed at the bánh mì cart lady on the corner who spreads him half the pâté she gives the guy in front of him every single morning

tracks.title: Tết Tóc Cho Em
tracks.subject: a husband learning to braid his wife's hair while her arm is in a cast

tracks.title: Cúp Điện Trên Sân Thượng
tracks.subject: neighbours dancing on an apartment rooftop during a summer power cut

tracks.title: Bố Chạy Theo Sau
tracks.subject: a father running behind his daughter's first motorbike ride in the alley

tracks.title: đầu lân là của tôi
tracks.mood: fierce and cocky, a cymbal girl taking the lion's head
tracks.subject: the first girl her ward's lion-dance troupe lets try out for the lion's head, and the Mid-Autumn night she has to keep to the drummer's beat on top of benches stacked three high

tracks.title: mở cửa lại ngày thứ tư
tracks.mood: hopeful and earnest, mud up to the knees
tracks.subject: a couple washing flood mud out of their Hội An lantern shop and reopening on the fourth day with the forty lanterns that survived and one lopsided new one

tracks.title: ai bấm chuông nhà ông Chín
tracks.mood: cheeky and jittery, an alley gang daring each other
tracks.subject: a gang of alley kids counting out with the xỉa cá mè đồng dao rhyme to pick who has to ring grumpy old Mr. Chín's gate bell and ask for their shuttlecock back off his tin roof

tracks.title: phạt nguội
tracks.subject: a traffic-camera fine arriving on the VNeID app for a red light run by the man you sold your old Wave to three years ago, who never transferred the papers

tracks.title: thả giỏ xuống đi em
tracks.subject: a student sending chicken rice porridge up to a feverish girl on the fourth floor of the girls' dorm in a plastic basket she lowers on a rope, after the guard will not let him in

tracks.title: mướp ơi, về nhà đi
tracks.mood: melodramatic and half laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a woman whose cat of four years moves across the alley to the bánh cuốn seller, who feeds it chả lụa, and ignores her calling it home

tracks.title: con chào mào học hát chèo
tracks.mood: comic and very proud of his own voice
tracks.subject: a man who swears his crested bulbul learned to sing from his chèo, and on contest morning at the village bird café it stays silent until he starts singing himself

tracks.title: ba vòng xoang
tracks.genre: Tây Nguyên t'rưng and gong EDM
tracks.mood: flirty and breathless, falling for someone in a dance circle
tracks.subject: holding a stranger's hand for three rounds of the xoang circle at a gong festival night in Pleiku, losing her when the circle breaks, and finding her at the rice-wine jar

tracks.title: không có bàn xoay
tracks.subject: a young Bàu Trúc potter who shapes pots by walking backwards around them, answering a tourist who keeps asking where the wheel is

tracks.title: đừng hắt xì
tracks.subject: a class monitor called up at the Monday flag ceremony to take the week's top-class emulation banner, thanking the whole school over the microphone while fighting off a sneeze

tracks.title: ngủ vỉa hè Hùng Vương
tracks.subject: camping overnight on a Hanoi pavement with strangers to watch the National Day parade rehearsal

tracks.title: xông đất mười bảy nhà
tracks.mood: cheerful and overbooked, sprinting between doorsteps
tracks.subject: being booked as the lucky first-footer by seventeen neighbours on the first morning of Tết because your birth year suits the new year

tracks.title: phòng 302 sau bảo vệ
tracks.mood: four years of deadlines let go in one night
tracks.subject: twelve classmates in karaoke room 302 the night after defending their graduation theses

tracks.title: bảy cặp kính lão
tracks.genre: Trinh Cong Son urban jazz-combo revival
tracks.subject: a husband who has hidden a spare pair of his wife's reading glasses in every room of the house

tracks.title: mười một ổ bánh mì
tracks.subject: buying the last eleven bánh mì on the slow first day of a friend's new cart after she quit her bank job

tracks.title: chốt đơn lúc mười một giờ
tracks.subject: a neighbour who livestreams face cream through the wall every night at eleven, and the mother who goes over to complain

tracks.title: đẩy xe qua Mã Pí Lèng
tracks.mood: furious, stubborn, then laughing at himself
tracks.subject: pushing a dead motorbike six kilometres up the Mã Pí Lèng pass after dark rather than let a friend call a truck

tracks.title: đo lại lần thứ ba
tracks.subject: a tailor on Lê Thánh Tôn street who measures her three times because neither of them wants the fitting to end

tracks.title: qua cầu Bến Thủy
tracks.mood: teasing and sweet, courting a girl and her mother at once
tracks.subject: riding across Bến Thủy bridge every Saturday to court a Hà Tĩnh girl whose mother answers everything with 'rứa à'

tracks.title: chờ một tiếng trống chầu
tracks.subject: a twenty-two-year-old's first ca trù performance and the single stroke of the praise drum she waits for

tracks.title: lên núi thăm em
tracks.mood: someone needing only to be seen
tracks.subject: a four-hour bus ride to visit a younger sister teaching twelve children at a mountain school

tracks.title: lễ đền đầu năm
tracks.mood: seeing your mother as a girl for one song
tracks.subject: a new year temple visit where you overhear your mother praying longest for you

tracks.title: dì tôi từng là đào hát
tracks.mood: a voice put away under the change drawer
tracks.subject: an aunt who ran a grocery stall for thirty years and once played the lead in cai luong

tracks.title: trận bóng bị hoãn
tracks.mood: finding out the ball was never the point
tracks.subject: fourteen men locked out of a booked five-a-side pitch for a VIP

tracks.title: mùa nồm
tracks.subject: Hanoi's humid season, damp walls, and a word written on a fogged window three times

tracks.title: lớp học thêm buổi tối
tracks.mood: the thing you were actually there for
tracks.subject: two hours of evening cram school nobody is actually studying in

tracks.title: cái quạt trần kêu
tracks.mood: a fault that turned into a home
tracks.subject: a ceiling fan that only rattles on speed three, so the family uses speed two for seven years

tracks.title: bà bán xôi đầu hẻm
tracks.genre: contemporary Vietnamese folk with dan bau
tracks.subject: twenty years of buying sticky rice from a woman who has never asked your name

tracks.title: áo mưa hai người
tracks.subject: the green two-person poncho and the three kilometres you drove slowly on purpose

tracks.title: điểm danh lớp cũ
tracks.genre: Vietnamese boom bap with live horns
tracks.mood: confirming your presence somewhere that no longer exists
tracks.subject: a twelve-years-later class chat group taking attendance in register order

tracks.title: hát sai bài quan họ
tracks.subject: being made to sing the old duet at a cousin's wedding and forgetting the middle

tracks.title: nhóm chat tôi vừa rời
tracks.mood: flat regret, three points of view
tracks.subject: leaving a four-year group chat and nobody messaging you privately

tracks.title: xe đạp của tôi ở đâu
tracks.mood: small private grief over an object
tracks.subject: a stolen bicycle, and the front basket your mother fitted

tracks.title: sao của ba
tracks.subject: a father losing sleep over his motorbike-taxi star rating

tracks.title: gương phòng gym
tracks.subject: going to a back-alley gym at six because it is the one thing you decide

tracks.title: Mình Nói Chuyện Tử Tế
tracks.subject: chia tay trong một quán cà phê

tracks.title: Dự Báo Sai
tracks.subject: chờ mưa mà trời không mưa

tracks.title: Chuyến Xe Bốn Giờ Sáng
tracks.subject: rời tỉnh lên thành phố trên chuyến xe sớm

tracks.title: Anh Hề Lắm
tracks.subject: tự cười mình sau khi thất bại

tracks.title: Bàn Thứ Ba Dãy Cuối
tracks.subject: mối tình đầu thời đi học

tracks.title: Xuân Đến Xuân Ơi
tracks.subject: swimming at night
